name: QL Resources Berhad
summary: QL Resources Berhad, an investment holding company, operates as an agro-food company in Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam, and internationally. It is involved in the deep-sea fishing and aquaculture farming activities; and manufacture and sale of fishmeal, surimi, surimi-based products, aquaculture livestock products, organic fertilizers, and halal food products; manufacturing, processing, and sale of animal feeds; and trading of feed supplement, animal health food, and agricultural products, as well as raw materials for animal feeds, lubricants, foodstuffs, and livestock.
